resources.string: Tell the subfeed server what you watch, subscribe to and keep in Watch Later and your playlists. Read only: it never changes anything in Grayjay (only the restore entries below do, after you confirm). The first time, a full backup is written to Android/data/…/files before anything is sent. Starts with the next app start or Sync now.
Send what\'s waiting to the server
Where the subfeed server is (default http://subfeed.wingert.internal)
subfeed: restore Watch Later from server snapshot
Replace Watch Later with the newest snapshot on the server (a backup of the current state is written first)
subfeed: restore Watch Later from local backup
Replace Watch Later with a backup file from Android/data/…/files (newest, or the first one from before subfeed)
subfeed: restore playlists from server snapshot
Bring back playlists that are missing or differ (newest snapshot by default). Never deletes or overwrites one: a changed playlist comes back as a new one named \"… (restored date)\"
subfeed: restore playlists from local backup
The same from a backup file in Android/data/…/files (newest by default)
